description: This Java class implements a command strategy for activating a client within the Apache Fineract project, specifically as part of batch processing. It handles extracting the client ID from the request URL, invokes the activate method on ClientsApiResource, and constructs a BatchResponse.

classes.name: ActivateClientCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements a command strategy to activate a client based on a batch request; retrieves client ID from URL, calls the clientsApiResource.activate method, and builds the batch response.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a batch request to activate a client, extracting the client ID from the URL, invoking the activation API, and returning the response.
